rules.statement: The yearly statutory leave entitlement shall be at least 4 times the employee's contractual weekly working time (entitledHours >= 4 x contractHoursPerWeek).
Recorded leave taken shall not exceed the total leave entitlement for the year (usedHours <= entitledHours + bovenwettelijkHours) — approved leave may never push a balance negative.
Statutory leave hours of a year shall lapse on 1 July of the following year; a balance carrying statutory hours records expiryDate = <year+1>-07-01.

rules.source: Regeling procesgang eerste en tweede ziektejaar art. 2 en 4; ZW art. 38 (42-wekenmelding, https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0002598)
rules.statement: The WVP milestone Due dates shall equal firstSickDay plus 6/8/42/52 weeks (probleemanalyse / plan van aanpak / UWV 42-wekenmelding / eerstejaarsevaluatie); on an open (gemeld) case none of the four Due dates may be null.

rules.source: Regeling procesgang eerste en tweede ziektejaar art. 2 en 4; ZW art. 38
rules.statement: An open (gemeld) case with a milestone Due date in the past and no matching Done date is a violation (mandatory); a Due date within 14 days and not yet Done is flagged as advisory, to be surfaced by occ hrmq:rules:audit.
During sickness the employer shall continue at least 70% of wages for the first 104 weeks; an open (gemeld) case shall carry loondoorbetalingPercentage >= 70.

rules.source: Wet op de identificatieplicht art. 15 jo. Wet LB 1964 art. 28 lid 1 onder f
rules.statement: The employer verifies the new hire's identity from an original WID document on or before the first workday and retains a copy; an onboarding case whose start date has passed (or that reports ready-for-first-workday or later) without widCheckDone violates.

A proeftijd may not exceed 1 month for fixed-term contracts shorter than 2 years and 2 months for permanent/2+ year contracts (deviations only by CAO); a running proeftijd past its end date must be explicitly closed.

The employee's loonheffingenverklaring (gegevens voor de loonheffingen) must be on file before the first payroll run; a ready-or-started onboarding whose Employee lacks loonheffingenVerklaringOnFile violates.
An active OrgAssignment (no endDate, or endDate not in the past) must reference an existing OrgUnit with active: true, and startDate <= endDate must hold whenever endDate is present.
An OrgUnit's parentUnitId ancestor chain must be acyclic — no unit may be its own (transitive) parent.

After a working day the employee has at least 11 hours of unbroken rest before the next working day starts: on consecutive calendar days, clockIn(D) minus clockOut(D-1) must be >= 11 hours for the same employee. The lawful once-per-7-days reduction to 8 hours is not modeled — this is the strict default norm.
A single dienst is at most 12 hours: clockOut minus clockIn must not exceed 12 hours, computed from the raw clock fields and never from a stored workedHours value.

Work of more than 5.5 hours requires at least 30 minutes of break; more than 10 hours requires at least 45 minutes, evaluated from breakMinutes against the elapsed clockOut minus clockIn using the tiers in parameters.breakTiers.

Dismissal-initiated departures (opzegging-werkgever; einde-contract non-renewal) carry a statutory transitievergoeding of 1/3 monthly wage per service year, capped at the indexed maximum or one annual salary if higher; an offboarding case at or past eindafrekening_gereed without a recorded transitievergoedingBedrag >= 0 violates.

parameters._note: TODO: capEur 98000 is the published 2025 indexed cap (Regeling indexering transitievergoeding); the 2026 figure could not be verified confidently at authoring time and MUST be replaced with the published 2026 number from wetten.overheid.nl before this constant is relied upon for computation.
parameters.capAlternative: one gross annual salary when higher than capEur

rules.statement: Untaken leave is paid out at end of employment; a completed (afgerond) offboarding case whose employee still holds a positive open leave balance (sum of entitledHours + bovenwettelijkHours - usedHours across LeaveBalance rows) without verlofsaldoUitbetaald violates. When no LeaveBalance row resolves for the employee the check is skipped (not fail-closed — balance rows are optional MVP data).

The employer provides a getuigschrift on the employee's request; a completed (afgerond) offboarding case without getuigschriftVerstrekt is flagged for HR verification (the MVP has no requested field, so the flag is advisory).

The HR master record's Employee.endDate equals the completed (afgerond) offboarding case's lastWorkingDay -- the statutory reference date for loonaangifte, pensioenafmelding and the ID-retention clock; a missing/empty endDate counts as a mismatch, and the check fails closed when employeeId does not resolve at afgerond.

A permanent employment contract recorded as written (writtenContract: true) shall have its arbeidsovereenkomst document on file -- an active GeneratedDocument of type arbeidsovereenkomst in status generated referencing the contract -- so the written-form precondition other rules rely on (nl-awf-laag-hoog-tarief) is evidenced, not merely asserted.
An open AssetAssignment (no innameDatum) must reference an existing Asset in status uitgegeven and an existing Employee, and uitgifteDatum <= innameDatum must hold whenever innameDatum is present.

rules.source: HR-administration control (offboarding asset return; goed werkgeverschap/werknemerschap, BW 7:611 sfeer)
rules.statement: An employee whose Offboarding is past its planned completion date SHOULD have no open AssetAssignments -- company property is returned as part of clean offboarding.
